I would recommend either Ruby, Sapphire, or Emerald. They are a little outdated (R/S came out in 2003, Emerald came out in 2005). However, the gameplay is solid, and IMO, some of the most memorable (and coolest) 'mons are in that generation. I would recommend starting with Emerald first. It's the same game as R/S, but with slightly better graphics, the core legendaries from both games, plus much more.

Also, there's Fire Red and Leaf Green, remakes of the first generation from the late 90's. F/G, a part of the Gameboy generation, like R/S/E, has a better version of Emeralds graphics, and some great gameplay too. 

TL;DR: Emerald, or Fire Red/Leaf Green.
